confidence.reason: 9 years of county yield data (2009–2023), model beats the trend baseline.

reasons.text: About 30% of this county's corn follows corn. Here corn and soybean are a small share of the cropland, so rotations aren't compared.
In years with excess rain from April to September, corn yields here tend to be about 10 bu/ac lower.
In years with a wet spring (planting delays), corn yields here tend to be about 4 bu/ac lower.

range_driver.text: What moves this county's corn range the most is season rain and water balance (Apr–Sep): from about -14 bu/ac in 2014 to about -2 bu/ac in 2018.
